name: Cubit Calculator Number Grid
author: Carl

sections.description:
The precise Royal Cubit (rc) – Paisley’s number sequence, is our ONE Universal Tool to compare Sacred Measurements in Numbers. A working tool to also accurately compare lengths and distances in between ancient artifacts and structures.

As outlined in The Divinity DΦdeca, the precise Royal Cubit (rc) is the original unit of measurement for all valuations in our Kingdom. Resynchronization creates alignment with the true Speed of Light, bringing all lost knowledge into Unified clarity Revelation by Revelation.

View full description

Number grid shortcode

This plugin provides a shortcode called cubit_number_grid you can use like this:

[cubit_number_grid]

[cubit_number_grid headings=true footers=false" rows=12 decimals=8]

[cubit_number_grid type="paisley" caption="Paisley sequence"]

[cubit_number_grid type="chi" footers=true caption="Xiquence"]<h3>Parameters</h3>

* type string (default=paisley) What type of number grid to use, “paisley” or “chi”
* headings bool (default=false) Enable/disable column headings
* rows int (default=9) Number of rows to show
* animate bool (default=true) Add a short delay between updating the fields
* caption string Custom caption to show below thenumber grid
* decimals int (default=6) How many decimal places to show in each field
* sharing bool (default=true) Enable/disable the share-as-link button
* copycsv bool (default=true) Enable/disable the copy-as-csv button

Unit converter shortcode

You can display a unit converter that converts to/from the Cubit (not the Royal Cubit):

[cubit_unit_convertor]

[cubit_unit_convertor restrict="inch,yard,deg-c,foot,terahertz" default="foot" decimals=8]<h3>Parameters</h3>

* restrict string A comma-separated list of units to make available. By default, all units from the Paisley sequence are available to the user. Options: terahertz,inch,foot,yard,nile,deg-c,khet,akhet,nautical-nile,quantum
* default string Which unit (slug) to select by default, e.g. default=”foot”
* decimals int (default=6) How many decimal places to use

Version 1.8.0

Release 13th November 2025

  • Adjusted the THz caclulation in the converter.
  • Adjusted the Mayan column in the Xiquence (x10).
  • Hide the Q column for Paisley

Version 1.7.0

Released 30th April 2025

  • Added a read-only field to the cubit unit converter that shows Mayan units when Terahertz is selected.
  • Minor adjustments to the Mile and Nautical Mile columns on the Paisley sequence.
  • Modified the PHP source to comply with phpcs WP ruleset.

Version 1.6.1

Released 24th April 2025

  • Minor adjustments to the Paisley Sequence 2Yard -> Mile and Mile -> Metre columns
  • Minor adjustments to the Paisley Sequence 2Yard -> Mile and Mile -> Mayan columns
  • Adjust number grid CSS to stop the Meter column from becoming too narrow.

Version 1.6.0

Released 2nd April 2025

  • Added 10 new number grid sequences based on time:
    • Paisley years
    • Sataya years
    • Treta years
    • Dwapara years
    • Lill Kali
    • Weeks
    • Days
    • Hours
    • Minutes
    • Seconds

Version 1.5.0

Released 16th February 2025

  • Added an option to the shortcode to display footers under the number grid table. Primarily for the Xiquence grid.
  • Added an option to the unit convertor so the THz unit also allows data entry in dB.

Version 1.4.1

Released 12th January 2025

  • Minor adjustments to the number sequence. Changed Yard to 2xYard.

Version 1.4.0

Released 7th January 2025

  • Added the new unit converter shortcode, to convert to/from the Cubit.

Version 1.3.2

Released 14th July 2024

  • More minor adjustments to the Xi sequence. Looks good now.

Version 1.3.1

Released 13th July 2024

  • Adjusted the maths in the Xi sequence number progression.

Version 1.3.0

Released 5th July 2024

  • Added an the type=”…” option to the shortcode so you can choose to a “paisley” or a “chi” number grid.
  • Tidied up some more rounding, so numbers like 302.3999999 will round up to 302.4.
  • Fixed a problem with the copy/share buttons when multiple number grids are on the same page.

Version 1.2.0

Released 3rd July 2024

  • New function to export/share number grids by copying to the clipboard as CSV data
  • Tidier rounding of numbers like 3000.00004 -> 3000

Version 1.1.0

Released 19th April 2024

  • New function to export/share number grids by copying a share-link

Version 1.0.2

Released 28th January 2024

  • Added sv-SE language
  • Updated the readme with a link to more info on the maths and some screenshots
  • Added ×8640 to the Yard column header

Version 1.0.1

Released 16th January 2024

  • Added en-GB language, although there isn’t much to translate here

Version 1.0.0

Released 10th November 2023

  • Initial release for code-review by wordpress.org
